title: mos.capacity.v1
description: Disc capacity emitted by `mos capacity --json`: how big is the loaded disc. NO capacity command is issued (design: doc/research/2026-06-13-read-capacity-feasibility.md). The whole-disk byte size is the kernel's cached attach-time READ CAPACITY, read off the IOMedia node as a registry property — no SCSI command, no exclusive access, so it works on MOUNTED media where a raw READ CAPACITY would return BUSY. The recordable view is READ TRACK INFORMATION via the same non-exclusive convenience read mos.metadata.v1's track_info uses. The two halves are INDEPENDENTLY nullable: a pressed disc carries media_bytes but no recordable view; a blank recordable carries no media_bytes (no whole-disk node until recorded) but a recordable view; an empty drive, neither.

bsd_node.description: Whole-disk dev node of the current media, or null when the drive carries no whole-disk IOMedia node (media absent). Addressing context for the disc this capacity describes.

media_bytes.description: Whole-disk capacity in bytes (kIOMediaSizeKey) — the kernel's cached READ CAPACITY result. null when there is no whole-disk node: a blank/unrecorded recordable disc or an empty drive. This is the READABLE capacity of recorded media; the FORMATTABLE capacity of a blank rewritable disc is reported separately under `formattable` (READ FORMAT CAPACITIES). KNOWN-UNKNOWN: this is the drive-reported whole-disk ADDRESSABLE capacity, NOT the filesystem's recorded-data extent — on a burned data disc it can exceed the ISO9660 Volume Space Size (lead-out runout / padding), and on overwritable media (DVD+RW/BD-RE) some firmwares report formatted rather than written capacity (the same caveat mos.metadata.v1's leadout_lba carries). The exact recorded-data length lives in the filesystem PVD (Volume Space Size × block size), a sector read mos does not perform (scope doctrine); do not treat media_bytes as a precise byte-exact image size.

block_bytes.description: Natural block size in bytes (kIOMediaPreferredBlockSizeKey) — 2048 for data optical, 2352 for audio. null whenever media_bytes is null (no size means no block size to report).

media_blocks.description: Whole-disk capacity in natural blocks (media_bytes / block_bytes). DERIVED, never separately reported; null whenever media_bytes or block_bytes is null.

recordable.description: The recordable / append-state view from READ TRACK INFORMATION (0x52) for the first track. null when the drive did not answer 0x52 — an empty drive, or a pressed disc with no readable first track. For single-track pressed media track_size is effectively the disc capacity; for a blank/appendable recordable, next_writable (when non-null) is the append point and free_blocks the remaining space.

free_blocks.description: Free blocks remaining in the track (Track Information Block Free Blocks).

next_writable.description: Next Writable Address (the append point), or null when the reply's NWA_V validity bit is clear (a closed/pressed track has no append point).

track_size.description: Track size in blocks (Track Information Block Track Size).

formattable.description: The formattable view from READ FORMAT CAPACITIES (0x23) — the capacities a REWRITABLE medium (DVD±RW, DVD-RAM, HD DVD-RAM/-RW, BD-RE) or BD-R reports, which media_bytes/recordable cannot give on a freshly blank rewritable (no whole-disk node yet, no track to read). Issued via the non-exclusive ReadFormatCapacities convenience method (MMCDeviceInterface), gated on the current PROFILE — only formattable media (the rewritable profiles + BD-R) is read, so pressed, write-once CD-R/DVD±R/HD DVD-R, and empty drives report null with no read attempted. No exclusive access, so the view is reported even on MOUNTED formattable media. mos reports these capacities; it never issues FORMAT UNIT.

type.description: Current/Maximum Capacity Descriptor type token (mos_format_capacity_type_name): 'unformatted' (1), 'formatted' (2), 'no_media' (3); null for a reserved code (0).

descriptors.description: Formattable Capacity Descriptors — the capacities the drive could FORMAT the medium to (DVD-RAM size choices, BD-RE format types). Empty when the drive lists none.

blocks.description: Number of blocks of this formattable capacity.

format_type.description: Raw Format Type code (descriptor byte 4 bits 7:2); media-specific, surfaced as the number.

param.description: Type-dependent parameter (descriptor bytes 5-7); the block length for the common format types.

allOf.title: media_bytes null forces block_bytes and media_blocks null
allOf.description: block_bytes and media_blocks have no meaning without a whole-disk size; reporting them when media_bytes is null would fabricate a reading.
